policy: Never download or train on footage unless its source entry is eligible and all required acceptance/provenance checks pass.

sources.name: Explicitly consented Mimir beta footage
sources.notes: Primary source for parked-car door dings and Tesla Sentry camera geometry. No background collection or upload.

sources.name: Nexar Collision Prediction Dataset
sources.notes: Useful for collision timing and hard negatives, but it is moving dashcam footage rather than parked Tesla door-ding footage. License attribution, no-resale, and ethical-use conditions must be retained.

sources.name: Open Images V7
sources.notes: Potential object/door imagery only. Annotations are CC BY 4.0 and listed images are CC BY 2.0, but Google explicitly requires verifying each image license.

sources.name: CCD and DoTA academic web-video datasets
sources.notes: Repository code licenses do not by themselves establish redistribution/training rights for every underlying web video.
